phases.name: All Four Elements
phases.say: Enough tricks. Let me show you the real thing.

say.open: Every power has a price. I set the prices.
say.death: The trick... was that it was never... magic...

bestiary.lore: The card of the one who has every tool on the table, and the mage of the old court who mastered them all and sold the rest.
bestiary.weakness: Holy and Dark: it wards only the four elements. Interrupt the storm while it charges.
bestiary.pattern: Wards itself every fourth turn, calls a three-row elemental storm every third, and bolts the weakest between. At half health the storm comes every other turn.
